about: Each state's earned income tax credit as a percent of the federal credit; 0 where the state has none.

source.quote: States and local governments with Earned Income Tax Credit ... California 46.5 percent Yes ... Connecticut 40 percent Yes ... Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 26-Nov-2025

specialCases: Maine, Minnesota, Oregon and Wisconsin set the credit by children, age of child or earned income rather than one percent; their 'pct' is a single stand-in (Maine and Oregon the base, Wisconsin the two-child percent, Minnesota 8 percent, about its $369 cap over the $4,427 one-child credit) and is marked an estimate.
